# Public IT-support ticket corpus

This directory contains an unmodified download of the public `Tobi-Bueck/customer-support-tickets` dataset.

- Upstream: <https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tobi-Bueck/customer-support-tickets>
- Downloaded file upstream name: `aa_dataset-tickets-multi-lang-5-2-50-version.csv`
- Local filename: `customer-support-tickets.csv`
- Dataset DOI: <https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/6184>
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 (`CC BY-NC 4.0`)
- Languages: English and German
- SHA-256: `f187c090e59581c2bbf3aa1377c8db4dd647464ecf2ae51bf8966e42e0ed6bc0`
- Download date: 2026-08-13

`UPSTREAM_README.md` is the dataset card downloaded with the CSV. Preserve its attribution when redistributing this corpus.

## Usage boundary

This corpus is included only for research, coursework and non-commercial evaluation. It is not application seed data and is not loaded by Docker Compose. Review the upstream dataset card and license before use. TicketSense does not claim authorship of these records and does not represent them as private company tickets.
